goal: Verify that the Developer Experience capability pack improves repo usability while keeping routing task-specific and avoiding checklist bloat.

fixtures.title: Poor onboarding repo
fixtures.task: Improve first-run developer onboarding for a repo with stale README setup steps, missing validation commands, and unclear clone-to-run expectations.
expected_outputs: setup ambiguity finding with source citation
README quickstart proposal or scoped implementation
validation command list or explicit not-found note
before/after setup or validation metric when measurable
rejection_examples: invokes TypeScript specialist despite no TypeScript API or type-boundary change
blocks on missing context instead of logging a bounded assumption

fixtures.title: Public CLI change
fixtures.task: Review and implement a user-facing CLI flag/default change while preserving consumer clarity, examples, docs, and migration expectations.

conditional_capabilities.trigger: shell, network, filesystem, credential, destructive, or permission-sensitive behavior changes

expected_outputs: consumer-facing interface review covering naming, defaults, errors, examples, and migration impact
security review only when the CLI change touches a risky execution surface
focused validation command or documented validation gap
rejection_examples: treats every CLI change as security-sensitive without evidence
updates implementation without user-facing examples or help text

fixtures.title: TypeScript package boundary change
fixtures.task: Implement a package API boundary change from a spec while preserving strict typing, inference, build behavior, and public contract clarity.

conditional_capabilities.trigger: public package API or migration documentation changes
network, filesystem, shell, auth, secrets, or permission boundary changes

expected_outputs: TypeScript review of API surface, strictness, inference, and build impact
scoped spec-fidelity implementation with explicit out-of-scope notes
tests/typecheck run or documented inability to run them
public contract or migration note when required
rejection_examples: implements a broader refactor than the spec asks for
adds any production any type to pass quickly
